advisory: The mandate is advisory: it is stored by this Petal and the agent can edit it. It filters bad drafts before the owner is asked; every vote still needs the owner's approval in a passkey ceremony. An owner-signed, binding mandate is future work.

body_schema.description: Every field is optional; a write replaces the whole mandate; {} clears it.

blocked_keywords.description: refuse proposals whose title or body contains one (case-insensitive)

spaces.description: allowed spaces; empty or absent = any space

enforced_by: votes/new.json, for new vote_ids: mandate_space_not_allowed (before any hub call), then after the hub checks mandate_blocked_keyword, mandate_reason_required, mandate_daily_limit. Each is a -3 refusal: nothing bound, no ceremony.
notes: at most 5 new votes per rolling 24 hours (bound votes, per network and account)
the mandate applies to new vote_ids only: a vote already bound is never re-checked
